readme:
# Reel

Custom animation solver for roblox.

Documentation: https://unityjaeger.github.io/reel/

files.source:
--!strict

const rig_load = require("./rig")
const easing_map = require("./easing_map")

export type PoseKey = {
	read time: number,

	read position: vector,
	read quat_vector: vector,
	read quat_scalar: number,

	read easing_function: (number) -> number,
}

export type Channel = {
	read count: number,
	read key_start: number,
}

export type Marker = {
	read time: number,
	read name: string,
	read value: string,
}

export type AnimationAsset = {
	read length: number,
	read pose_length: number,
	read looped: boolean,
	read priority: number,

	read channels: { Channel },
	read name_to_channel: { [string]: number },

	read markers: { Marker },

	read key_times: { number },
	read key_inv_durations: { number },
	read key_positions: { vector },
	read key_quat_vectors: { vector },
	read key_quat_scalars: { number },
	read key_easing_functions: { (number) -> number },
}

export type MarkerAsset = {
	read length: number,
	read markers: { Marker },
}

export type AnimationBinding = {
	read active_count: number,
	read active_rig_indices: { number },
	read active_channel_indices: { number },
}

const function quat_normalize(v: vector, s: number): (vector, number)
	local length = math.sqrt(vector.dot(v, v) + s * s)

	if length == 0 then
		return vector.zero, 1
	end

	local inv = 1 / length
	return v * inv, s * inv
end

const function clone_pose_key_at_time(key: PoseKey, time: number): PoseKey
	return table.freeze({
		time = time,

		position = key.position,
		quat_vector = key.quat_vector,
		quat_scalar = key.quat_scalar,

		easing_function = key.easing_function,
	})
end

const function pack_channel(
	keys: { PoseKey },
	key_times: { number },
	key_inv_durations: { number },
	key_positions: { vector },
	key_quat_vectors: { vector },
	key_quat_scalars: { number },
	key_easing_functions: { (number) -> number }
): Channel
	table.sort(keys, function(a: PoseKey, b: PoseKey)
		return a.time < b.time
	end)

	if keys[1] ~= nil and keys[1].time > 0 then
		table.insert(keys, 1, clone_pose_key_at_time(keys[1], 0))
	end

	local count = #keys
	local key_start = #key_times + 1

	local channel: Channel = {
		count = count,
		key_start = key_start,
	}

	for index, key in keys do
		local quat_vector, quat_scalar = quat_normalize(key.quat_vector, key.quat_scalar)
		local key_index = key_start + index - 1

		key_times[key_index] = key.time
		key_positions[key_index] = key.position
		key_quat_vectors[key_index] = quat_vector
		key_quat_scalars[key_index] = quat_scalar
		key_easing_functions[key_index] = key.easing_function
	end

	for index = 1, count - 1 do
		local key_index = key_start + index - 1
		local duration = key_times[key_index + 1] - key_times[key_index]

		if duration <= 0 then
			error("channel has duplicate or descending keyframe times")
		end

		key_inv_durations[key_index] = 1 / duration
	end

	return table.freeze(channel)
end

type PoseKeyBuckets = { [string]: { PoseKey } }

const function get_sequence_keyframes(sequence: KeyframeSequence): { Keyframe }
	local keyframes = sequence:GetKeyframes() :: { Keyframe }

	table.sort(keyframes, function(a: Keyframe, b: Keyframe)
		return a.Time < b.Time
	end)

	if #keyframes == 2 and keyframes[1].Time ~= 0 then
		error("unsupported KeyframeSequence, only 2 keyframes exist and neither of them are at Time = 0")
	end

	return keyframes
end

const function read_markers(keyframes: { Keyframe }): (number, { Marker })
	local markers: { Marker } = {}
	local length = 0

	for _, keyframe in keyframes do
		for _, marker: KeyframeMarker in keyframe:GetMarkers() do
			table.insert(markers, table.freeze({
				time = keyframe.Time,
				name = marker.Name,
				value = marker.Value,
			}))
		end

		length = keyframe.Time
	end

	table.freeze(markers)

	return length, markers
end

const function add_pose_key(out: PoseKeyBuckets, name: string, key: PoseKey)
	local keys = out[name]
	if keys == nil then
		keys = {}
		out[name] = keys
	end

	table.insert(keys, key)
end

const function read_pose_tree(
	pose: Pose,
	time: number,
	out: PoseKeyBuckets,
	seen_at_time: { [string]: string },
	first_path_by_name: { [string]: string },
	parent_path: string
)
	local name = pose.Name
	local path = if parent_path == "" then name else parent_path .. "/" .. name

	for _, child in pose:GetSubPoses() :: { Pose } do
		read_pose_tree(child, time, out, seen_at_time, first_path_by_name, path)
	end

	if pose.Weight == 0 then
		return
	end

	local duplicate_path = seen_at_time[name]
	if duplicate_path ~= nil then
		error(`duplicate animation target "{name}" at time {time}: "{duplicate_path}" and "{path}"`)
	end
	seen_at_time[name] = path

	local first_path = first_path_by_name[name]
	if first_path == nil then
		first_path_by_name[name] = path
	elseif first_path ~= path then
		error(`ambiguous animation target "{name}" appears at both "{first_path}" and "{path}"`)
	end

	local cframe = pose.CFrame
	local axis, angle = cframe:ToAxisAngle()
	local half_angle = angle * 0.5

	add_pose_key(out, name, table.freeze({
		time = time,
		position = cframe.Position :: any,
		quat_vector = math.sin(half_angle) * axis :: any,
		quat_scalar = math.cos(half_angle),
		easing_function = easing_map[pose.EasingStyle][pose.EasingDirection],
	}))
end

const function load_keyframe_sequence(sequence: KeyframeSequence): AnimationAsset
	local keyframes = get_sequence_keyframes(sequence)
	local length, markers = read_markers(keyframes)

	local pose_keys_by_name: PoseKeyBuckets = {}
	local first_path_by_name: { [string]: string } = {}

	local pose_length = 0

	for _, keyframe in keyframes do
		local poses = keyframe:GetPoses()
		if #poses == 0 then
			continue
		end

		pose_length = keyframe.Time

		local seen_at_time: { [string]: string } = {}

		for _, root_pose: Pose in poses do
			read_pose_tree(root_pose, keyframe.Time, pose_keys_by_name, seen_at_time, first_path_by_name, "")
		end
	end

	local sorted_names = {}
	for name in pose_keys_by_name do
		table.insert(sorted_names, name)
	end
	table.sort(sorted_names)

	local channels: { Channel } = table.create(#sorted_names) :: { Channel }
	local name_to_channel: { [string]: number } = {}
	local key_times: { number } = {}
	local key_inv_durations: { number } = {}
	local key_positions: { vector } = {}
	local key_quat_vectors: { vector } = {}
	local key_quat_scalars: { number } = {}
	local key_easing_functions: { (t: number) -> number } = {}

	for channel_index, name in sorted_names do
		channels[channel_index] = pack_channel(
			pose_keys_by_name[name],
			key_times,
			key_inv_durations,
			key_positions,
			key_quat_vectors,
			key_quat_scalars,
			key_easing_functions
		)
		name_to_channel[name] = channel_index
	end

	local priority = sequence.Priority
	local priority_value = priority.Value
	if priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Core then
		--Core has a value of 1000, which would make it the highest priority so we have to do something like this
		priority_value = -1
	end

	table.freeze(channels)
	table.freeze(name_to_channel)
	table.freeze(key_times)
	table.freeze(key_inv_durations)
	table.freeze(key_positions)
	table.freeze(key_quat_vectors)
	table.freeze(key_quat_scalars)
	table.freeze(key_easing_functions)

	return table.freeze({
		length = length,
		pose_length = pose_length,
		looped = sequence.Loop,
		priority = priority_value,

		channels = channels,
		name_to_channel = name_to_channel,

		markers = markers,

		key_times = key_times,
		key_inv_durations = key_inv_durations,
		key_positions = key_positions,
		key_quat_vectors = key_quat_vectors,
		key_quat_scalars = key_quat_scalars,
		key_easing_functions = key_easing_functions,
	})
end

const function bind_animation(asset: AnimationAsset, rig_or_desc: rig_load.Rig | rig_load.RigDesc): AnimationBinding
	local value = rig_or_desc :: any
	local desc: rig_load.RigDesc = value.desc or value

	local active_rig_indices = {}
	local active_channel_indices = {}
	local active_count = 0

	for rig_index = 1, desc.count do
		local channel_index = asset.name_to_channel[desc.names[rig_index]]

		if channel_index ~= nil then
			active_count += 1
			active_rig_indices[active_count] = rig_index
			active_channel_indices[active_count] = channel_index
		end
	end

	table.freeze(active_rig_indices)
	table.freeze(active_channel_indices)

	return table.freeze({
		active_count = active_count,
		active_rig_indices = active_rig_indices,
		active_channel_indices = active_channel_indices,
	})
end

const function extract_markers(sequence: KeyframeSequence): MarkerAsset
	local length, markers = read_markers(get_sequence_keyframes(sequence))

	return table.freeze({
		length = length,
		markers = markers,
	})
end

return {
	load_keyframe_sequence = load_keyframe_sequence,
	extract_markers = extract_markers,
	bind_animation = bind_animation,
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2
--!native

const function linear(t: number): number
	return t
end

const function in_cubicv2(t: number): number
	return t * t * t
end

const function out_cubicv2(t: number): number
	local t1 = t - 1
	return t1 * t1 * t1 + 1
end

const function in_out_cubicv2(t: number): number
	return if t < .5 then 4 * t * t * t else (t - 1) * (2 * t - 2) * (2 * t - 2) + 1
end

const in_cubic = out_cubicv2
const out_cubic = in_cubicv2
const in_out_cubic = in_out_cubicv2

const c4 = math.tau / 3
const c5 = math.tau / 4.5

const function in_elastic(t: number): number
	if t == 0 or t == 1 then
		return t
	end

	return -(2 ^ (10 * t - 10)) * math.sin((10 * t - 10.75) * c4)
end

const function out_elastic(t: number): number
	if t == 0 or t == 1 then
		return t
	end

	return (2 ^ (-10 * t)) * math.sin((10 * t - 0.75) * c4) + 1
end

const function in_out_elastic(t: number): number
	if t == 0 or t == 1 then
		return t
	end

	if t < 0.5 then
		return -((2 ^ (20 * t - 10)) * math.sin((20 * t - 11.125) * c5)) / 2
	end

	return ((2 ^ (-20 * t + 10)) * math.sin((20 * t - 11.125) * c5)) / 2 + 1
end

const function out_bounce(t: number): number
	const n1 = 7.5625
	const d1 = 2.75

	if t < 1 / d1 then
		return n1 * t * t
	elseif t < 2 / d1 then
		t -= 1.5 / d1
		return n1 * t * t + .75
	elseif t < 2.5 / d1 then
		t -= 2.25 / d1
		return n1 * t * t + .9375
	else
		t -= 2.625 / d1
		return n1 * t * t + .984375
	end
end

const function in_bounce(t: number): number
	return 1 - out_bounce(1 - t)
end

const function in_out_bounce(t: number): number
	if t < .5 then
		return in_bounce(t * 2) * .5
	end
	
	return (out_bounce((t * 2) - 1) * .5) + .5
end

const function in_constant(t: number): number
	return math.ceil(t)
end

const function out_constant(t: number): number
	return math.floor(t)
end

const function in_out_constant(t: number): number
	return math.round(t)
end

return {
	linear = linear,
	
	in_cubic = in_cubic,
	out_cubic = out_cubic,
	in_out_cubic = in_out_cubic,
	
	in_cubicv2 = in_cubicv2,
	out_cubicv2 = out_cubicv2,
	in_out_cubicv2 = in_out_cubicv2,
	
	in_bounce = in_bounce,
	out_bounce = out_bounce,
	in_out_bounce = in_out_bounce,
	
	in_elastic = in_elastic,
	out_elastic = out_elastic,
	in_out_elastic = in_out_elastic,
	
	in_constant = in_constant,
	out_constant = out_constant,
	in_out_constant = in_out_constant
}

--!strict

export type RigDesc = {
	read count: number,

	read names: { string },
	read parent: { number },

	read is_bone: { boolean },

	read name_to_index: { [string]: number },

	read c0: { CFrame },
	read c1_inv: { CFrame },
	read bind: { CFrame },
}

export type BlendScratch = {
	weight: { number },
	position: { vector },
	quat_vector: { vector },
	quat_scalar: { number },

	group_weight: { number },
	group_touched: { number },
}

export type AnimationJoint = Motor6D | AnimationConstraint

export type RigState = {
	desc: RigDesc,

	motors: { AnimationJoint? },
	bones: { Bone? },

	transforms: { CFrame },
	world_transforms: { CFrame }?, -- allocated by get_world_transforms when needed

	blend_scratch: BlendScratch?, -- allocated explicitly through allocate_blend_scratch
}

export type Rig = RigState

type RawNode = {
	order: number,
	key: Instance,
	parent_key: Instance?,
	name: string,

	is_bone: boolean,
	motor: AnimationJoint?,
	bone: Bone?,

	c0: CFrame,
	c1: CFrame,
	bind: CFrame,

	depth: number?,
}

const IDENTITY = CFrame.identity

const function freeze_rig_desc(desc: RigDesc): RigDesc
	table.freeze(desc.names)
	table.freeze(desc.parent)
	table.freeze(desc.is_bone)
	table.freeze(desc.name_to_index)
	table.freeze(desc.c0)
	table.freeze(desc.c1_inv)
	table.freeze(desc.bind)

	return table.freeze(desc)
end

const function create_rig_state(desc: RigDesc, motors: { AnimationJoint? }?, bones: { Bone? }?): RigState
	local result: RigState = {
		desc = desc,

		motors = motors or {},
		bones = bones or {},

		transforms = table.create(desc.count, IDENTITY),
		world_transforms = nil,
		blend_scratch = nil,
	}

	return result
end

const function create_blend_scratch(desc: RigDesc): BlendScratch
	local count = desc.count
	return {
		weight = table.create(count, 0),
		position = table.create(count, vector.zero),
		quat_vector = table.create(count, vector.zero),
		quat_scalar = table.create(count, 0),
		group_weight = table.create(count, 0),
		group_touched = {},
	}
end

const function allocate_blend_scratch(rig: RigState): BlendScratch
	local scratch = rig.blend_scratch
	if scratch == nil then
		scratch = create_blend_scratch(rig.desc)
		rig.blend_scratch = scratch
	end

	return scratch :: BlendScratch
end

const function get_world_transforms(rig: RigState): { CFrame }
	local world_transforms = rig.world_transforms
	if world_transforms == nil then
		world_transforms = table.create(rig.desc.count) :: { CFrame }
		rig.world_transforms = world_transforms
	end

	return world_transforms :: { CFrame }
end

const function add_node(raw_nodes: { RawNode }, key_to_raw: { [Instance]: number }, node: RawNode)
	if key_to_raw[node.key] ~= nil then
		error(`duplicate rig target instance: {node.key:GetFullName()}`)
	end

	table.insert(raw_nodes, node)
	key_to_raw[node.key] = #raw_nodes
end

const function depth(raw_nodes: { RawNode }, visiting: { [number]: boolean }, key_to_raw: { [Instance]: number }, raw_index: number): number
	local cached = raw_nodes[raw_index].depth
	if cached ~= nil then
		return cached
	end

	if visiting[raw_index] then
		error("cycle in rig hierarchy")
	end

	visiting[raw_index] = true

	local parent_key = raw_nodes[raw_index].parent_key
	local parent_raw = if parent_key ~= nil then key_to_raw[parent_key] else nil

	local result = if parent_raw ~= nil then depth(raw_nodes, visiting, key_to_raw, parent_raw) + 1 else 0

	visiting[raw_index] = nil
	raw_nodes[raw_index].depth = result

	return result
end

const function read_raw_nodes(rig: Model): { RawNode }
	local raw_nodes: { RawNode } = {}
	local key_to_raw: { [Instance]: number } = {}

	for order, motor: AnimationJoint in rig:QueryDescendants("Motor6D, AnimationConstraint") do
		local part0 = motor.Part0
		local part1 = motor.Part1

		if part0 == nil or part1 == nil then
			error(`{motor.ClassName} has nil Part0/Part1: {motor:GetFullName()}`)
		end

		if motor:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and not motor.IsKinematic then
			error(`AnimationConstraint must have IsKinematic enabled: {motor:GetFullName()}`)
		end

		add_node(raw_nodes, key_to_raw, {
			order = order,
			key = part1,
			parent_key = part0,
			name = part1.Name,

			is_bone = false,
			motor = motor,
			bone = nil,

			c0 = motor.C0,
			c1 = motor.C1,
			bind = IDENTITY,
		})
	end

	for order, bone: Bone in rig:QueryDescendants("Bone") do
		local parent = bone.Parent
		local parent_key =
			if parent ~= nil and (parent:IsA("Bone") or parent:IsA("BasePart"))
			then parent
			else nil

		add_node(raw_nodes, key_to_raw, {
			order = order,
			key = bone,
			parent_key = parent_key,
			name = bone.Name,

			is_bone = true,
			motor = nil,
			bone = bone,

			c0 = IDENTITY,
			c1 = IDENTITY,
			bind = bone.CFrame,
		})
	end

	local visiting: { [number]: boolean } = {}

	for index in raw_nodes do
		depth(raw_nodes, visiting, key_to_raw, index)
	end

	table.sort(raw_nodes, function(a, b)
		if a.depth ~= b.depth then
			return (a.depth :: number) < (b.depth :: number)
		end

		return (a.order :: number) < (b.order :: number)
	end)

	return raw_nodes
end

const function build_rig(raw_nodes: { RawNode }): (RigDesc, { AnimationJoint? }, { Bone? })
	local count = #raw_nodes
	local desc: RigDesc = {
		count = count,
		names = table.create(count) :: { string },
		parent = table.create(count) :: { number },
		is_bone = table.create(count) :: { boolean },
		name_to_index = {},
		c0 = table.create(count) :: { CFrame },
		c1_inv = table.create(count) :: { CFrame },
		bind = table.create(count) :: { CFrame },
	}

	local motors: { AnimationJoint? } = {}
	local bones: { Bone? } = {}

	local key_to_index: { [Instance]: number } = {}

	for index, node in raw_nodes do
		key_to_index[node.key] = index
	end

	for index, node in raw_nodes do
		if desc.name_to_index[node.name] ~= nil then
			error(`duplicate animation target name: {node.name}`)
		end

		desc.names[index] = node.name
		desc.name_to_index[node.name] = index

		desc.parent[index] = if node.parent_key ~= nil then key_to_index[node.parent_key] or 0 else 0
		desc.is_bone[index] = node.is_bone
		motors[index] = node.motor
		bones[index] = node.bone

		desc.c0[index] = node.c0
		desc.c1_inv[index] = node.c1:Inverse()
		desc.bind[index] = node.bind
	end

	return freeze_rig_desc(desc), motors, bones
end

const function read_rig(rig: Model): (RigDesc, { AnimationJoint? }, { Bone? })
	return build_rig(read_raw_nodes(rig))
end

const function load_rig_desc(rig: Model): RigDesc
	local desc = read_rig(rig)
	return desc
end

local function bind_raw_nodes(desc: RigDesc, raw_nodes: { RawNode }): ({ AnimationJoint? }, { Bone? })
	if #raw_nodes ~= desc.count then
		error(`rig target count mismatch: expected {desc.count}, got {#raw_nodes}`)
	end

	local name_to_raw: { [string]: RawNode } = {}
	local key_to_raw: { [Instance]: RawNode } = {}

	for _, node in raw_nodes do
		if name_to_raw[node.name] ~= nil then
			error(`duplicate animation target name: {node.name}`)
		end

		name_to_raw[node.name] = node
		key_to_raw[node.key] = node
	end

	local motors: { AnimationJoint? } = {}
	local bones: { Bone? } = {}

	for index = 1, desc.count do
		local name = desc.names[index]
		local node = name_to_raw[name]
		if node == nil then
			error(`rig is missing animation target "{name}"`)
		end

		if node.is_bone ~= desc.is_bone[index] then
			error(`rig target type mismatch for "{name}"`)
		end

		local expected_parent_index = desc.parent[index]
		local expected_parent_name = if expected_parent_index == 0 then nil else desc.names[expected_parent_index]
		local actual_parent = if node.parent_key == nil then nil else key_to_raw[node.parent_key]
		local actual_parent_name = if actual_parent == nil then nil else actual_parent.name

		if actual_parent_name ~= expected_parent_name then
			error(`rig parent mismatch for "{name}": expected "{expected_parent_name}", got "{actual_parent_name}"`)
		end

		if desc.is_bone[index] then
			if not node.bind:FuzzyEq(desc.bind[index]) then
				error(`rig bind CFrame is outside tolerance for Bone "{name}"`)
			end
		elseif not node.c0:FuzzyEq(desc.c0[index])
			or not node.c1:Inverse():FuzzyEq(desc.c1_inv[index])
		then
			error(`rig C0/C1 is outside tolerance for joint target "{name}"`)
		end

		motors[index] = node.motor
		bones[index] = node.bone
	end

	return motors, bones
end

const function bind_rig(desc: RigDesc, rig: Model): RigState
	local motors, bones = bind_raw_nodes(desc, read_raw_nodes(rig))
	return create_rig_state(desc, motors, bones)
end

const function load_rig(rig: Model): RigState
	local desc, motors, bones = read_rig(rig)
	return create_rig_state(desc, motors, bones)
end

return {
	create_rig_state = create_rig_state,
	allocate_blend_scratch = allocate_blend_scratch,
	get_world_transforms = get_world_transforms,
	load_rig_desc = load_rig_desc,
	bind_rig = bind_rig,
	load_rig = load_rig
}

--!strict
--!optimize 2

const rig_load = require("./rig")
const animation_load = require("./animation")

type Channel = animation_load.Channel
type AnimationAsset = animation_load.AnimationAsset
type AnimationBinding = animation_load.AnimationBinding
type BlendScratch = rig_load.BlendScratch
type Rig = rig_load.Rig

const IDENTITY = CFrame.identity
const VEC_ZERO = vector.zero
const EPS = 1e-5
const FLT_EPS = 1e-7

export type AnimationState = {
	binding: AnimationBinding,

	time_position: number,

	weight: number,

	priority: number?,
}

export type PlayingTrack = {
	asset: AnimationAsset,
	state: AnimationState,
}

export type DeltaMode = "additive" | "subtractive"

export type DeltaState = {
	binding: AnimationBinding,
	time_position: number,
	weight: number,
}

export type DeltaTrack = {
	asset: AnimationAsset,
	state: DeltaState,
	mode: DeltaMode,
}

export type PreparedDeltaTrack = {
	asset: AnimationAsset,
	state: DeltaState,
	inverse: boolean,
}

export type PreparedDelta = {
	count: number,
	tracks: { PreparedDeltaTrack },
}

export type PreparedTrack = {
	asset: AnimationAsset,
	state: AnimationState,
	priority: number,
}

export type PriorityGroup = {
	start: number,
	stop: number,
}

export type PreparedPlaying = {
	count: number,
	tracks: { PreparedTrack },

	group_count: number,
	groups: { PriorityGroup },
}

const function quat_normalize(v: vector, w: number): (vector, number)
	local len = math.sqrt(vector.dot(v, v) + w * w)
	if len < FLT_EPS then
		return vector.zero, 1
	end

	local inv = 1 / len
	return v * inv, w * inv
end

local function quat_nlerp(v0: vector, w0: number, v1: vector, w1: number, t: number): (vector, number)
	if vector.dot(v0, v1) + w0 * w1 < 0 then
		v1 = -v1
		w1 = -w1
	end

	local out_v, out_w = quat_normalize(
		vector.lerp(v0, v1, t),
		math.lerp(w0, w1, t)
	)

	return out_v, out_w
end

const function sample_channel(asset: AnimationAsset, channel: Channel, target_time: number): (vector, vector, number)
	local count = channel.count
	local key_start = channel.key_start
	local times = asset.key_times

	local positions = asset.key_positions
	local quat_vectors = asset.key_quat_vectors
	local quat_scalars = asset.key_quat_scalars

	if count == 0 then
		return VEC_ZERO, VEC_ZERO, 1
	end

	local key_stop = key_start + count - 1

	if count == 1 or target_time <= times[key_start] then
		return positions[key_start], quat_vectors[key_start], quat_scalars[key_start]
	end

	if target_time >= times[key_stop] then
		return positions[key_stop], quat_vectors[key_stop], quat_scalars[key_stop]
	end

	local left = key_start

	if count > 2 then
		local low = key_start
		local high = key_stop

		while low <= high do
			local mid = (low + high) // 2
			if times[mid] == target_time then
				return positions[mid], quat_vectors[mid], quat_scalars[mid]
			elseif times[mid] < target_time then
				left = mid
				low = mid + 1
			else
				high = mid - 1
			end
		end
	end

	local right = left + 1

	local alpha = (target_time - times[left]) * asset.key_inv_durations[left]
	alpha = asset.key_easing_functions[left](alpha)

	local position = vector.lerp(positions[left], positions[right], alpha)

	local qv, qs = quat_nlerp(
		quat_vectors[left],
		quat_scalars[left],
		quat_vectors[right],
		quat_scalars[right],
		alpha
	)

	return position, qv, qs
end

const function get_priority(asset: AnimationAsset, state: AnimationState): number
	local state_priority = state.priority
	if state_priority ~= nil then
		return state_priority
	end

	return asset.priority
end

const function sort_tracks_by_priority(a: PreparedTrack, b: PreparedTrack): boolean
	return a.priority > b.priority
end

const function create_prepared_playing(): PreparedPlaying
	return {
		count = 0,
		tracks = {},

		group_count = 0,
		groups = {},
	}
end

const function write_prepared_track(tracks: { PreparedTrack }, index: number, asset: AnimationAsset, state: AnimationState)
	local priority = get_priority(asset, state)
	local track = tracks[index]

	if track == nil then
		tracks[index] = {
			asset = asset,
			state = state,
			priority = priority,
		}
	else
		track.asset = asset
		track.state = state
		track.priority = priority
	end
end

const function rebuild_priority_groups(prepared: PreparedPlaying)
	local tracks = prepared.tracks
	local groups = prepared.groups
	local old_group_count = prepared.group_count
	local track_count = prepared.count

	local group_count = 0
	local group_start = 1

	while group_start <= track_count do
		local group_priority = tracks[group_start].priority
		local group_stop = group_start + 1

		while group_stop <= track_count and tracks[group_stop].priority == group_priority do
			group_stop += 1
		end

		group_count += 1

		local group = groups[group_count]
		if group == nil then
			groups[group_count] = {
				start = group_start,
				stop = group_stop,
			}
		else
			group.start = group_start
			group.stop = group_stop
		end

		group_start = group_stop
	end

	for index = group_count + 1, old_group_count do
		groups[index] = nil
	end

	prepared.group_count = group_count
end

const function finish_prepared(prepared: PreparedPlaying, count: number, old_count: number): PreparedPlaying
	local tracks = prepared.tracks

	for index = count + 1, old_count do
		tracks[index] = nil
	end

	prepared.count = count

	if count > 1 then
		table.sort(tracks, sort_tracks_by_priority)
	end

	rebuild_priority_groups(prepared)

	return prepared
end

const function prepare_tracks(playing_tracks: { PlayingTrack }, out: PreparedPlaying?): PreparedPlaying
	local prepared = out or create_prepared_playing()
	local tracks = prepared.tracks
	local old_count = prepared.count
	local count = #playing_tracks

	for index = 1, count do
		local playing_track = playing_tracks[index]
		write_prepared_track(tracks, index, playing_track.asset, playing_track.state)
	end

	return finish_prepared(prepared, count, old_count)
end

const function create_prepared_delta(): PreparedDelta
	return {
		count = 0,
		tracks = {},
	}
end

const function prepare_delta_tracks(
	delta_tracks: { DeltaTrack },
	out: PreparedDelta?
): PreparedDelta
	local prepared = out or create_prepared_delta()
	local tracks = prepared.tracks
	local old_count = prepared.count
	local count = #delta_tracks

	for index = 1, count do
		local delta_track = delta_tracks[index]
		local mode = delta_track.mode
		local inverse: boolean

		if mode == "additive" then
			inverse = false
		elseif mode == "subtractive" then
			inverse = true
		else
			error(`unknown delta track mode: {mode}`)
		end

		local track = tracks[index]

		if track == nil then
			tracks[index] = {
				asset = delta_track.asset,
				state = delta_track.state,
				inverse = inverse,
			}
		else
			track.asset = delta_track.asset
			track.state = delta_track.state
			track.inverse = inverse
		end
	end

	for index = count + 1, old_count do
		tracks[index] = nil
	end

	prepared.count = count
	return prepared
end

const function solve_single_track(rig: Rig, track: PreparedTrack)
	local desc = rig.desc
	local transforms = rig.transforms
	local rig_count = desc.count
	local state = track.state
	local track_weight = state.weight
	local binding = state.binding
	local active_count = binding.active_count

	if track_weight <= EPS then
		for rig_index = 1, rig_count do
			transforms[rig_index] = IDENTITY
		end
		return
	end

	if active_count < rig_count then
		for rig_index = 1, rig_count do
			transforms[rig_index] = IDENTITY
		end
	end

	local real_time = state.time_position
	local asset = track.asset
	local channels = asset.channels
	local active_rig_indices = binding.active_rig_indices
	local active_channel_indices = binding.active_channel_indices

	for active_index = 1, active_count do
		local rig_index = active_rig_indices[active_index]
		local channel_index = active_channel_indices[active_index]
		local pos, qv, qs = sample_channel(asset, channels[channel_index], real_time)

		if track_weight < 1 then
			pos *= track_weight

			if qs < 0 then
				qv = -qv
				qs = -qs
			end

			qv *= track_weight
			qs = qs * track_weight + 1 - track_weight
			qv, qs = quat_normalize(qv, qs)
		end

		transforms[rig_index] = CFrame.new(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, qv.x, qv.y, qv.z, qs)
	end
end

const function solve_prepared(rig: Rig, prepared: PreparedPlaying)
	local desc = rig.desc
	local rig_count = desc.count
	local transforms = rig.transforms

	local tracks = prepared.tracks
	local groups = prepared.groups
	local group_count = prepared.group_count

	local effective_count = 0
	local single_track: PreparedTrack? = nil

	for track_index = 1, prepared.count do
		local track = tracks[track_index]
		if track.state.weight > EPS and track.state.binding.active_count > 0 then
			effective_count += 1
			single_track = track

			if effective_count == 2 then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if effective_count == 0 then
		for rig_index = 1, rig_count do
			transforms[rig_index] = IDENTITY
		end
		return
	elseif effective_count == 1 then
		solve_single_track(rig, single_track :: PreparedTrack)
		return
	end

	local scratch = rig.blend_scratch :: BlendScratch
	local blend_weight = scratch.weight
	local blend_position = scratch.position
	local blend_qv = scratch.quat_vector
	local blend_qs = scratch.quat_scalar
	local group_weight = scratch.group_weight
	local group_touched = scratch.group_touched

	for i = 1, rig_count do
		blend_weight[i] = 0
		blend_position[i] = VEC_ZERO
		blend_qv[i] = VEC_ZERO
		blend_qs[i] = 0
	end

	for group_index = 1, group_count do
		local group = groups[group_index]
		local group_start = group.start
		local group_stop = group.stop

		local touched_count = 0

		for track_index = group_start, group_stop - 1 do
			local track = tracks[track_index]
			local track_weight = track.state.weight

			if track_weight <= EPS then
				continue
			end

			local binding = track.state.binding
			local active_rig_indices = binding.active_rig_indices

			for active_index = 1, binding.active_count do
				local rig_index = active_rig_indices[active_index]

				if blend_weight[rig_index] >= 1 - EPS then
					continue
				end

				if group_weight[rig_index] <= 0 then
					touched_count += 1
					group_touched[touched_count] = rig_index
				end

				group_weight[rig_index] += track_weight
			end
		end

		for touched_index = 1, touched_count do
			local rig_index = group_touched[touched_index]
			local total_weight = group_weight[rig_index]
			local remaining = 1 - blend_weight[rig_index]

			if remaining <= EPS then
				group_weight[rig_index] = 0
			elseif total_weight > remaining then
				group_weight[rig_index] = remaining / total_weight
			else
				group_weight[rig_index] = 1
			end
		end

		for track_index = group_start, group_stop - 1 do
			local track = tracks[track_index]
			local state = track.state
			local track_weight = state.weight

			if track_weight <= EPS then
				continue
			end

			local real_time = state.time_position
			local binding = state.binding
			local asset = track.asset
			local channels = asset.channels
			local active_rig_indices = binding.active_rig_indices
			local active_channel_indices = binding.active_channel_indices

			for active_index = 1, binding.active_count do
				local rig_index = active_rig_indices[active_index]
				local scale = group_weight[rig_index]

				if scale <= EPS then
					continue
				end

				local effective_weight = track_weight * scale
				local channel_index = active_channel_indices[active_index]
				local pos, qv, qs = sample_channel(asset, channels[channel_index], real_time)

				local current_weight = blend_weight[rig_index]
				local acc_qv = blend_qv[rig_index]
				local acc_qs = blend_qs[rig_index]

				if current_weight > 0 and vector.dot(acc_qv, qv) + acc_qs * qs < 0 then
					qv = -qv
					qs = -qs
				end

				blend_position[rig_index] += pos * effective_weight
				blend_qv[rig_index] += qv * effective_weight
				blend_qs[rig_index] += qs * effective_weight
				blend_weight[rig_index] = current_weight + effective_weight
			end
		end

		for touched_index = 1, touched_count do
			group_weight[group_touched[touched_index]] = 0
		end
	end

	for rig_index = 1, rig_count do
		local weight = blend_weight[rig_index]

		if weight <= EPS then
			transforms[rig_index] = IDENTITY
		else
			local pos = blend_position[rig_index]
			local qv = blend_qv[rig_index]
			local qs = blend_qs[rig_index]

			if weight < 1 then
				if qs < 0 then
					qv = -qv
					qs = -qs
				end

				qs += 1 - weight
			else
				local inv = 1 / weight
				pos *= inv
				qv *= inv
				qs *= inv
			end

			qv, qs = quat_normalize(qv, qs)
			transforms[rig_index] = CFrame.new(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, qv.x, qv.y, qv.z, qs)
		end
	end
end

const function apply_delta_prepared(rig: Rig, prepared: PreparedDelta)
	local transforms = rig.transforms
	local tracks = prepared.tracks

	for track_index = 1, prepared.count do
		local track = tracks[track_index]
		local state = track.state
		local weight = state.weight

		if weight <= EPS then
			continue
		end

		local binding = state.binding
		local asset = track.asset
		local inverse = track.inverse
		local channels = asset.channels
		local active_rig_indices = binding.active_rig_indices
		local active_channel_indices = binding.active_channel_indices
		local real_time = state.time_position

		for active_index = 1, binding.active_count do
			local rig_index = active_rig_indices[active_index]
			local channel_index = active_channel_indices[active_index]
			local pos, qv, qs = sample_channel(asset, channels[channel_index], real_time)

			if weight < 1 then
				pos *= weight

				if qs < 0 then
					qv = -qv
					qs = -qs
				end

				qv *= weight
				qs = qs * weight + 1 - weight
				qv, qs = quat_normalize(qv, qs)
			end

			local delta = CFrame.new(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, qv.x, qv.y, qv.z, qs)
			if inverse then
				delta = delta:Inverse()
			end

			transforms[rig_index] = transforms[rig_index] * delta
		end
	end
end

const function compute_world_transforms(rig: Rig, root_cframe: CFrame, out: { CFrame }?): { CFrame }
	local desc = rig.desc
	local world_transforms = out or rig_load.get_world_transforms(rig)
	local local_transforms = rig.transforms
	local parent = desc.parent
	local is_bone = desc.is_bone
	local c0 = desc.c0
	local c1_inv = desc.c1_inv
	local bind = desc.bind

	for rig_index = 1, desc.count do
		local parent_index = parent[rig_index]
		local parent_world = if parent_index == 0 then root_cframe else world_transforms[parent_index]
		local local_transform = local_transforms[rig_index]

		if is_bone[rig_index] then
			world_transforms[rig_index] = parent_world * (bind[rig_index] :: CFrame) * local_transform
		else
			world_transforms[rig_index] = parent_world * (c0[rig_index] :: CFrame) * local_transform * (c1_inv[rig_index] :: CFrame)
		end
	end

	return world_transforms
end

return {
	prepare_tracks = prepare_tracks,
	prepare_delta_tracks = prepare_delta_tracks,
	solve_prepared = solve_prepared,
	apply_delta_prepared = apply_delta_prepared,
	compute_world_transforms = compute_world_transforms
}
